name: rptw-publication-api
description: FastAPI backend for Repent and Prepare the Way: articles, full-text search and categories.

ADMIN_TOKEN.description: Bearer token required for POST/PATCH/DELETE. The frontend's ADMIN_TOKEN must be set to the same value.

CORS_ORIGINS.description: Comma-separated origins allowed to call this API from a browser.

DB_CONNECTION_LIMIT.description: Connections the database plan allows in total (Essential-0: 20, Essential-1: 40). The per-worker pool is divided to stay under it.
